"'''Visitor's Day / The Growing Green Danger'''" is the tenth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 2]], [[2023]].<ref name="More YJA Episodes" />

==Official description==
''Jedi track down artifacts stolen from the town's fair. Nubs plants a seed that grows out of control.''
